body:
StepStone Secondary Opportunities Fund VI is reportedly targeting $6 billion in capital commitments.

The fund's 2023-vintage predecessor closed with $212 million in capital commitments, according to SecondaryLink Data .

The new tool makes it easier to understand fundraising and filing activity across the secondary market, including continuation vehicles, closed-end secondary funds, and evergreen secondary funds.

The firm is reportedly eyeing €500 million in commitments for an inaugural fund.

Its next private equity flagship is slated for early 2027, while parent company EQT is laying the groundwork for an infrastructure secondaries platform.

Nimble Partners Opportunities Fund III is targeting $200 million in capital commitments, SecondaryLink has learned.

Following the establishment of a dedicated GP-led secondaries team earlier this year, the London-based firm has reportedly secured around €1 billion at first close.

The firm's lower fees in its flagship secondary funds will be offset by growth in its private wealth assets, according to CFO David Park.

The alternatives manager also gave updates on the fundraising status of several other secondaries strategies spanning private equity, GP-leds, venture capital, and infrastructure.

The milestone coincided with the first close of the firm's inaugural GP-led fund, securing $200 million in capital commitments.
